text:
MQTT::type
Description
This command gets the type of MQTT messages, which is a string
representation of MQTT message types:
CONNECT
CONNACK
PUBLISH
PUBACK
PUBREC
PUBREL
PUBCOMP
SUBSCRIBE
SUBACK
UNSUBSCRIBE
UNSUBACK
PINGREQ
PINGRESP
DISCONNECT
Syntax
MQTT
::
type
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
MQTT_CLIENT_INGRESS, MQTT_SERVER_INGRESS, MQTT_CLIENT_DATA,
MQTT_SERVER_DATA
